The main takeaway from our work is that
there are no clear advantages to sampling epilithic diatoms in streams over epiphytic and/or epipelic diatoms, at least not for the two streams that we sampled in southern Ontario.
the diatom communities in the three habitats are not consistently different, and therefore there is no benefit to sampling discrete habitat types for water quality biomonitoring using diatoms.
